text.content:
A New York mob family that came west for the Mob Wars, and fell in the Purge.

Kind: Crime family (broken)
Base: Night City; originally New York
Leadership: Don Falcone, who "died in custody" in 2048
Purpose: Once, the city's underworld

The Falcones came west for the Mob Wars and stayed. In September 2047 the Don's heir, Luigi Falcone, married Roxanne Lawrence on a live broadcast to the whole continent, because the Static Night bomber had threatened to drop another Moon rock on the city if they didn't. The stage was bombed at the vows, and Luigi Falcone was never seen again under that name.

The Purge List gutted what was left of the Falcone street crews. The Don died in custody in 2048. Of his three sons, Luigi vanished after the wedding, Mario disappeared during the Purge (some say he resurfaced in New York and is rebuilding the family there), and a third son disappeared when they were all boys; the family never spoke his name afterward.

GM secrets

From the Hall of Justice file sealed in 2047, held by Commissioner Ramos: the Don paid for Luigi's gene-tailoring before birth and combat chrome from the age of twelve to make a prince nobody could kill, and it cost Luigi his anger control. In the wreck of his own wedding Luigi joined the crew that ended Static Night, fought beside them for forty-eight hours, and testified for the city. In return he got clemency, rushed treatment (therapy, neural dampers and a chip he never mentions) and a new name in MaxTac special ops: Lorenzo "Contender" Lawrence, with the bride's surname. The Purge crew know. None of them has told.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 10
